notes.text: Codification Section, Pub. L. 103–444, § 2, Nov. 2, 1994, 108 Stat. 4632, which set out congressional findings and purposes, was omitted from the Code as being of special and not general application.
Short TitlePub. L. 103–444, § 1, Nov. 2, 1994, 108 Stat. 4632, provided that Pub. L. 103–444, enacting this subchapter, could be cited as the “Crow Boundary Settlement Act of 1994”.
